title: Note deletion refusals bypass the shared notice and durable diagnostic boundary
surface: Notes query and editor delete action
organization_context: Existing visible note; diagnostics-enabled member organization; native roles unverified
preconditions: softDeleteNote receives a database error or a count other than exactly one.
reproduction: Run pnpm check:swallowed-refusals on repair base: Notes reports 6 sites against budget 5.
Run the new src/lib/notes/queries.delete-failures.test.ts against the original query: five failure cases resolve false rather than rejecting with a recorded DbFailureError.
expected: Failed or unconfirmed deletion uses failDbCall to announce a remedy, submit a structured diagnostic when diagnostics is enabled, and reject; only exactly one affected row confirms success. The editor retains the note and draft on rejection.
actual: At source level, softDeleteNote routes database errors and every affected-row count other than exactly one through failDbCall, which records the shared notice and diagnostic before rejecting. The editor retains the pending draft and exposes Retry delete after rejection. Native behavior remains unverified.
